#5435: PR #5600. tools/aoe2_lang.py reads the string tables of a local AoE2 DE install. It matches each English name of lang.name() to its string ID in the English table and writes the other languages into the resource pack of a world. The repository has no AoE2 text. The first quick CI failed: the new data file needed its line in KEYS of tests/test_converter_data.py. Fixed; CI is green. Not checked: level 4 (no install, no client).
